en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a wooden building surrounded by trees, labeled 'Sundsvall Vid Turistpaviljongen'. A large group of people dressed in early 20th-century attire is gathered in front of the building, suggesting a social or tourist gathering. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, an address to Stockholm, a 10 öre Swedish stamp with a portrait of Berzelius, and a dated postmark.
